ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) NTDS.dit dump via ntdsutil IFM 'create full'
ucs.description: Hunts the exact AD-database extraction chain CISA AA24-038A attributed to Volt Typhoon: ntdsutil invoked with 'ac i ntds' + 'ifm' + 'create full' (often wrapped in 'wmic process call create') to write a copy of NTDS.dit and the SYSTEM hive to C:\Windows\Temp for offline DCSync/cracking. CrowdStrike tracks this same cluster as VANGUARD PANDA; Secureworks as BRONZE SILHOUETTE.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where (Processes.process_name=ntdsutil.exe OR Processes.process="*ntdsutil*") AND (Processes.process="*ifm*" OR Processes.process="*create full*" OR Processes.process="*ac i ntds*" OR Processes.process="*activate instance ntds*") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | eval is_wmic_wrapped=if(match(parent_process,"(?i)wmic.*process.*call.*create"),1,0) | eval volt_signature=if(match(process,"(?i)c:\\\\windows\\\\temp\\\\Pro"),1,0) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit dump via ntdsutil IFM — CISA AA24-038A signature
let IfmTokens = dynamic(["ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds"]);
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName =~ "ntdsutil.exe" or ProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "ntdsutil")
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any (IfmTokens)
    or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any (IfmTokens)
| extend WmicWrapped = (InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wmic.exe" and InitiatingProcessCommandLine has_any ("process call create","process call"))
| extend VoltPath = ProcessCommandLine has @"C:\Windows\Temp\Pro" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has @"C:\Windows\Temp\Pro"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, AccountDomain,
          FileName, ProcessCommandLine,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandparentImage = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          WmicWrapped, VoltPath, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit dump via ntdsutil IFM — 4688 path
let IfmTokens = dynamic(["ifm","create full","ac i ntds","activate instance ntds"]);
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where (NewProcessName endswith "\\ntdsutil.exe" or CommandLine has "ntdsutil")
| where CommandLine has_any (IfmTokens)
| extend WmicWrapped = ParentProcessName endswith "\\wmic.exe"
| extend VoltPath = CommandLine has @"C:\Windows\Temp\Pro"
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, SubjectDomainName,
          NewProcessName, CommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, WmicWrapped, VoltPath, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon NTDS.dit dump via ntdsutil IFM create full
id: aa24038a-volt-ntdsutil-ifm
status: experimental
description: Detects use of ntdsutil with the Install From Media (IFM) options to extract NTDS.dit and the SYSTEM hive — the exact AD credential-dump chain attributed to Volt Typhoon (Vanguard Panda) by CISA AA24-038A.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
author: Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_proc:
    - Image|endswith: '\ntdsutil.exe'
    - CommandLine|contains: 'ntdsutil'
  selection_ifm:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'ifm'
      - 'create full'
      - 'ac i ntds'
      - 'activate instance ntds'
  condition: selection_proc and selection_ifm
fields:
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Authorised DC backups using ntdsutil IFM (validate ticket + operator)
level: critical
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\ntdsutil.exe OR *\Ntdsutil.exe OR *\NTDSUTIL.exe) OR @CommandLine:(*ntdsutil* OR *Ntdsutil* OR *NTDSUTIL*)) @CommandLine:(*ifm* OR *IFM* OR *"create full"* OR *"Create Full"* OR *"ac i ntds"* OR *"activate instance ntds"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 (ImageFileName=/\\ntdsutil\.exe$/i OR CommandLine=/ntdsutil/i) CommandLine=/(\bifm\b|create\s+full|ac\s+i\s+ntds|activate\s+instance\s+ntds)/i
| WmicWrapped := if(ParentBaseFileName=/wmic\.exe$/i, "true", "false")
| VoltTempPath := if(CommandLine=/C:\\Windows\\Temp\\Pro/i, "true", "false")

ucs.title: [LLM] Volt Typhoon (Voltzite/Vanguard Panda) netsh portproxy v4tov4 reverse-proxy establishment
ucs.description: Hunts the 'netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4' command that Volt Typhoon uses to turn a compromised internal host into a relay for C2 traffic that egresses through their KV-botnet of compromised SOHO routers — a hallmark living-off-the-land pivot called out by CISA AA24-038A and Microsoft's Volt Typhoon advisory. Same cluster CrowdStrike tracks as VANGUARD PANDA and Dragos as VOLTZITE.
ucs.splunk: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=netsh.exe AND Processes.process="*interface*" AND Processes.process="*portproxy*" AND (Processes.process="*add v4tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v4tov6*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov4*" OR Processes.process="*add v6tov6*") by host Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | rex field=process "(?i)listenport[\s=]+(?<listen_port>\d+).*?connectaddress[\s=]+(?<connect_addr>[\w\.\:]+).*?connectport[\s=]+(?<connect_port>\d+)" | eval suspicious_parent=if(match(parent_process_name,"(?i)(w3wp|java|sshd|tomcat|httpd|nginx|wsmprovhost|wmiprvse)\.exe"),1,0) | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime) | sort - lastTime
ucs.kql:
// Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy add v4tov4 — KV-botnet reverse proxy pivot
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where FileName =~ "netsh.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "interface" and ProcessCommandLine has "portproxy"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort   = extract(@"(?i)listenport[\s=]+(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddr  = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress[\s=]+([\w\.\:]+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort  = extract(@"(?i)connectport[\s=]+(\d+)", 1, ProcessCommandLine)
| extend SuspiciousParent = InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("w3wp.exe","java.exe","sshd.exe","tomcat.exe","httpd.exe","nginx.exe","wsmprvhost.exe","wmiprvse.exe","cmd.exe","powershell.exe")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
   or SuspiciousParent  // keep webshell-driven invocations even if SYSTEM
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ProcessCommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          SuspiciousParent, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy add — Sentinel 4688 path
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\netsh.exe"
| where CommandLine has "interface" and CommandLine has "portproxy"
| where CommandLine has_any ("add v4tov4","add v4tov6","add v6tov4","add v6tov6")
| extend ListenPort   = extract(@"(?i)listenport[\s=]+(\d+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectAddr  = extract(@"(?i)connectaddress[\s=]+([\w\.\:]+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend ConnectPort  = extract(@"(?i)connectport[\s=]+(\d+)", 1, CommandLine)
| extend SuspiciousParent = ParentProcessName has_any ("\\w3wp.exe","\\java.exe","\\sshd.exe","\\tomcat.exe","\\httpd.exe","\\nginx.exe","\\wsmprvhost.exe","\\wmiprvse.exe")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, Account = SubjectUserName, NewProcessName,
          CommandLine, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort,
          ParentProcessName, SuspiciousParent
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Volt Typhoon netsh portproxy v4tov4 reverse-proxy establishment
id: aa24038a-volt-portproxy
status: experimental
description: Detects use of 'netsh interface portproxy add v4tov4/v4tov6/v6tov4/v6tov6' — the LOLBin port-forward Volt Typhoon (Voltzite / Vanguard Panda) uses to relay C2 traffic onto their KV-botnet of compromised SOHO routers, per CISA AA24-038A and the Microsoft Volt Typhoon advisory.
references:
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories/aa24-038a
  - https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/security/blog/2023/05/24/volt-typhoon-targets-us-critical-infrastructure-with-living-off-the-land-techniques/
author: Detection Engineering
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_image:
    Image|endswith: '\netsh.exe'
  selection_cli_all:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'interface'
      - 'portproxy'
  selection_cli_action:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'add v4tov4'
      - 'add v4tov6'
      - 'add v6tov4'
      - 'add v6tov6'
  condition: selection_image and selection_cli_all and selection_cli_action
fields:
  - CommandLine
  - ParentImage
  - User
falsepositives:
  - Legacy IPv4/IPv6 bridging for line-of-business apps (rare; allow-list per host)
level: high
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1090.001
  - attack.t1090.003
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) @Image:(*\netsh.exe OR *\Netsh.exe OR *\NETSH.exe) @CommandLine:(*interface* OR *Interface* OR *INTERFACE*) @CommandLine:(*portproxy* OR *PortProxy* OR *PORTPROXY*) @CommandLine:(*"add v4tov4"* OR *"add v4tov6"* OR *"add v6tov4"* OR *"add v6tov6"*)
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\netsh\.exe$/i CommandLine=/interface\s+portproxy/i CommandLine=/add\s+v[46]tov[46]/i
| ListenPort   := regex("(?i)listenport[\\s=]+(?<ListenPort>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectAddr  := regex("(?i)connectaddress[\\s=]+(?<ConnectAddr>[\\w\\.:]+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| ConnectPort  := regex("(?i)connectport[\\s=]+(?<ConnectPort>\\d+)", field=CommandLine, strict=false)
| SuspiciousParent := if(ParentBaseFileName=/(w3wp|java|sshd|tomcat|httpd|nginx|wsmprvhost|wmiprvse)\.exe$/i, "true", "false")
| table([@timestamp, aid, ComputerName, UserName, CommandLine, ParentBaseFileName, ListenPort, ConnectAddr, ConnectPort, SuspiciousParent])
| sort(@timestamp, order=desc)
ucs.rationale: netsh portproxy add v4tov4 is a near-zero-baseline command in enterprise environments and is the specific LOLBin Volt Typhoon uses to chain compromised internal hosts into their KV-botnet ORB infrastructure (CISA AA24-038A § 'Network Configuration Changes'). The extracted listen/connect tuple plus the suspicious-parent enrichment (web-shell processes like w3wp.exe or sshd.exe spawning netsh) catch
_sigma_issues: sigma parse error: Sigma rule identifier must be an UUID
